packages.aboutPackage: Kashmir, the jewel in the crown of India, is one of the most gorgeous and highly visited tourist destinations in the country. Among all the different places to visit in this magnificent region, its capital city, Srinagar, is considered the epicentre of Kashmir tourism. During this exciting tour of Srinagar, you will get to visit several scenic hill stations, mountain peaks, enchanting rivers, and much more. Along with these experiences, you will also have the opportunity to enjoy Shikara rides on the beautiful Dal Lake, pony rides, and even participate in an enthralling trek. While in Srinagar, you will also get to explore some of its most popular and unmissable landmarks.
